name: iamigos
description: Pixel-art critters in the GNOME top bar showing what your Claude Code and OpenCode sessions are doing.
author: jaalmansa

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.pack-extension: glib-compile-schemas gnome-extension/iamigos@iamigos/schemas && gnome-extensions pack gnome-extension/iamigos@iamigos --force --out-dir dist --extra-source=sprites.js --extra-source=i18n.js --extra-source=strings.js --extra-source=whip.js --schema=schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.iamigos.gschema.xml
